items.Sentence: The original wastewater treatment systems consisted of four 6,000-gallon septic tanks and subsurface leach dispersal fields on each side (northbound and southbound).
In 1993, Caltrans upgraded the Facility and installed two 24,000-gallon septic tanks and expanded the leach fields on both the northbound and southbound sides of I-15.
The septic tank’s effluent filters at the southbound comfort station are missing. The septic tank’s effluent filters at the northbound comfort station are severely damaged.
Prior to constructing a replacement wastewater treatment plant, the content of the existing septic tanks will be pumped out and sewage waste properly disposed off-site.

the northbound and southbound effluent wastewater flows will be combined for treatment in a single treatment system with new septic tanks installed...Conceptually, the Discharger has proposed a new wastewater treatment system that will reduce total nitrogen to below 10 mg/L prior to disposal at the leach-fields.
